notes.title: Delearnia now on mobile & Big updates on playability
notes.content:
Delearnia: Fractions of Hope is available for both Android and Apple mobile devices. For experiencing the full beauty of the game on mobile, we recommend tablet devices, althought the game works very well on phone screens too.

Become the Mathemagician, anywhere, anytime!

PC game updates
- Particle effects have been optimised for better performance.
- Difficulty of all the bosses has been adjusted for better experience.

notes.title: Everything improved, and more
notes.content:
Delearnia has become a must place to visit for those searching for the mystery and fun in math. All the players we've interviewed so far have stated that Delearnia is the best math related game they've ever played. We are only getting started. This fall we'll publish the mobile version of the game for iOS and Android, making the game much more accessable. 

While we work hard on the mobile port, we've also improved gamepad support, implemented save system fixes for Steam Deck and improved gameplay across the board for the Steam version. 

Finally, the [b]free demo [/b]of Delearnia is back on Steam. Let your friends know, they'll most likely enjoy the game. 

[b]Don't be afraid of math. Make the math afraid of you![/b]

notes.title: Best educational game of 2023 is now out as a full game!
notes.content:
Delearnia: Fractions of Hope won the audience vote in The Best Learning Solution from Finland competition in 2023. Now in 2024, the full version of the game is finally out.

Back then the game was still in beta. Now, with a full game, we are ready to be the audience favourite once more. We invite students, parents and gamers to dive into Delearnia and become the Mathemagician.

- Hall of the Endless Well area first door: Tutorial made more clear for controller players.

notes.title: +-÷× Developer playing Delearnia: Fractions of Hope ×÷-+
notes.content:
[b]Game developer Jussi Koivisto plays through the demo and shows some areas of the full game.[/b]
[i]Description of the game: It's a puzzle-adventure with metroidvania elements and touch of mathematics. The game is designed to reignite your enjoyment of math whether you hate, fear, or love math.[/i]

I'm excited to discuss the game and more. 

If like what you see, consider adding the game to your wishlist. It will be release in August.

FAQ:
Is this an educational game?
[i]This is not your typical educational game. It's the game industry's best attempt to create an exciting game that can give you benefits. You'll practise math while you play but the math is seamless part of the world, story and gameplay.[/i]

Can I play on a controller?
[i]Yes, you can. The controls might feel a bit more complex compared to keyboard & mouse but it's very much enjoyable. If you have trouble with controls or controllers, please let us hear your suggestions to make the experience better! [/i]
